dirty_repeat.interpretation: Longer one-client repetition is +0.29% with mixed paired directions, contradicting a consistent regression or improvement claim.

mixed_tpcc.interpretation: Two-client median -1.84%, eight-client +8.22%; paired directions disagree at both. Shared evolving dataset and time-seeded RNG prevent a stable whole-workload gain claim.
